scenarios.title: Two workers, one operation
scenarios.explanation: An exclusive claim precedes the callback. Only one worker enters it.

scenarios.title: Same ID after return
scenarios.explanation: The returned callback is recorded; retry is suppressed, not re-executed.

scenarios.title: Same ID, changed payload
scenarios.explanation: An operation ID cannot be reused with a different proposal digest.

scenarios.title: Worker exits after claim
scenarios.explanation: The old claim survives a process exit. Outcome is unknown and no retry occurs.

scenarios.title: Callback throws after possible effect
scenarios.explanation: The ledger records uncertainty and suppresses a replay; a host must reconcile externally.

scenarios.title: New ID, same payload
scenarios.explanation: A separate host intent may intentionally repeat the same payload.

limits: Local trusted filesystem only. Callback counts are simulated; returned is not proof of external delivery. No automatic recovery, cross-machine guarantee, human authentication, or production authorization.
